notes.title: Development News and Demo Update
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings![/h2][h3]The development of [i]YOKAI GODDESS[/i] continues![/h3][p]The First Act is about 75% complete. The action segments, including levels and bosses, are ready. The main focus now is on cutscenes and adventure sections, about half of which are already complete.[/p][p]If work keeps progressing at the current pace, the release of the First Act can be expected around December 2025.[/p][p]Screenshots from the First Act:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546735/e60321d76ebb79414e94ccb8f52f1c0f49b684a2.png"][/img][i]The ritual[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546735/3d604c37a399a65af83855eb789192dc13e32bfe.png"][/img][i]Soy beans![/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546735/0e096e67dd14c107b21eeec7cbf175dcbaf053f7.png"][/img][i]Escape[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]08/29 Demo Update[/h2][h3]New Features:[/h3][p]- Gamepad support
- Customizable controls
- Level rank screen[/p][h3]Fixes:[/h3][p]- Critical bug when trying to parry the boss’s fire projectiles
- Visual bug where the blinking silhouette didn’t match the boss sprite[/p][h3]Balance:[/h3][p]- Reduced boss health
- Reworked dash attack timings[/p][h3]Other:[/h3][p]- Minor text adjustments[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546735/b81a52c0c55e4119d6eb6bf7e2e1ced9930600ac.jpg"][/img][i]Customizable controls[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546735/e3cb7f16141428652d75ef51158ec3cd1833ae9e.jpg"][/img][i]Level rank screen[/i][/p]
